monetization.noteEs: Sistema gacha con personajes y light cones obtenibles por warps usando stellar jades. El juego es full single-player con endgame rotativo (Memory of Chaos, Pure Fiction, Apocalyptic Shadow), completable como F2P pero obtener personajes 5-estrellas específicos puede requerir gasto significativo. Las microtransacciones incluyen battle pass, supply pass mensual y bundles de currency.
monetization.noteEn: Gacha system with characters and light cones obtained via warps using stellar jades. The game is fully single-player with rotating endgame modes (Memory of Chaos, Pure Fiction, Apocalyptic Shadow), completable as F2P but obtaining specific 5-star characters can require significant spending. Microtransactions include battle pass, monthly supply pass, and currency bundles.
